title: Grid-connected LFP battery storage system
description:
Design a grid-connected lithium iron phosphate battery energy storage system for a site in Germany. Requirements at the point of connection to the 10 kV network: usable energy 3 MWh and rated power 3 MW (charge and discharge, 1 h duration) over a service life of 10 years. Apply the NASA Systems Engineering Handbook technical margin policy at CDR: 10% on energy and 15% on power. End of life is 80% state of health. Usable energy follows the PNNL ESGC 2022 definitions (SOC window, state of health, and the DC, PCS and transformer efficiencies between cells and the point of connection; DC-side one-way efficiency 0.959).

Architecture: one string per rack, strings in parallel on a common DC bus into the PCS units; cells in series in modules of 16 (the series count is a multiple of 16). Each string has one fuse and one contactor and runs to the PCS over one DC cable pair (optionally several pairs in parallel) of 40 m route length, with 4 strings sharing each cable tray. DC circuit time constant L/R 2 ms. DC cable voltage drop limit 3%.

Site: maximum ambient 35 C, annual mean 12 C, altitude 500 m; cable ambient inside the enclosure 35 C.

Cell (LFP prismatic): 3.2 V nominal, 300 Ah, 2.5-3.65 V, DC resistance 0.57 mOhm at beginning of life growing by a factor 1.8 at end of life, continuous 0.5 C charge and discharge, operating SOC window 10-95%, open-circuit voltage 3.08 V at 10% SOC, maximum cell temperature 55 C, price 69.78 per cell.

Design rules to apply, by name: string voltage window against the PCS DC window at end of life; PCS output at site ambient per the catalog columns; cooling at site ambient; string fuse selection per IEC 60269-7 (battery fuse class, DC voltage rating at the circuit time constant, ambient factor from the catalog, continuous-load factor 0.8, breaking capacity against the prospective fault current at the DC bus per IEC 61660-1 with the PCS contribution from the catalog); contactor coordination with the fuse (no interruption gap); DC cable current-carrying capacity per DIN VDE 0298-4 with the temperature and grouping factors below and overload coordination per IEC 60364-4-43 (DIN VDE 0100-430); reactive power capability at the point of connection per VDE-AR-N 4110 (cos phi 0.95 under- and over-excited) including the transformer's own reactive consumption from its short-circuit impedance; transformer rating per IEC 60076-11 with the annual-mean ambient factors below.

Eaton 'Five factors' OCPD note: fuse and contactor interruption coordination (no gap)

IEC 60076-11 dry-type transformer rated conditions and annual-mean ambient factors as stated in Siemens GEAFOL planning notes
